name: Daily goals
summary: Today's steps, active minutes and water, each as a bar against its goal with a check when it's met, a hint for the step goal, and a week of small bars you can tap to see a past day.
use: on the home screen of a fitness or health app, for today's progress against daily goals
a11y: Each goal's bar is a meter named after the goal, with its value and maximum; the count of goals met and the date are text; each day in the week strip is a button with its date as its name and aria-pressed for the day shown.

use_when: a wellness or habit screen with two to four daily targets that reset each day
avoid_when: a streak of yes-or-no habits across days: use habit-tracker
one big savings or long-term target: use savings-goal
a single finished workout's stats: use workout-summary

parts.name: date
parts.what: the day shown; it changes when a past day is picked

parts.name: count
parts.what: how many goals are met that day

parts.name: goals
parts.what: one goal: icon, name, value against the goal, a check when met, and a bar

parts.name: value
parts.what: the day's value and its goal with the unit

parts.name: bar
parts.what: a meter of the value against the goal

parts.name: hint
parts.what: one line on the first goal: how far to go, or that it is met

parts.name: week
parts.what: one day of the week: a small bar of that day's first goal and its initial; pressing it shows that day

empty.how: the Smart UI renderer puts one plain 'Nothing to show yet.' line in an empty list

loading.how: the Smart UI renderer draws each marked slot as a quiet block of its size while the data arrives; the static file shows the filled part

error.how: if the day cannot load, put the reason and a retry in the hint box, or an alert-banners line above the goals

disabled.how: set disabled on future days in the week strip and dim them

overflow.how: a bar never runs past its track, however far over the goal the value goes

long_text.how: goal names and the hint wrap; values and the met count never wrap
long_text.evidence: .odl-daily-goals .odl-val { justify-self: end; font: var(--ds-text-title-md); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; white-space: nowrap; }

keyboard: Tab reaches each day in the week strip
Enter or Space on a day shows that day's goals, date and hint, and marks the day as pressed
